g.aria-label: 1:1 Before anything had a name, God made tha heavenz N tha earth. Whole creation started wit him. 1:2 Earth had no shape, nothing filled tha space. Darkness over tha deep, but God’s Spirit was swaggin over tha waterz. 1:3 God said, “Let there b light.” He spoke it; light showed up. 1:4 God peeped tha light was good N separated it from tha darkness. Each had its place. 1:5 He named tha light Day N tha darkness Night. Evening, then morning—day 1. 1:6 God said, “Put an expanse between tha waterz. Give tha waterz a dividing line.”
